title: Graphics cards
none: No NVIDIA or AMD graphics card found by the drivers.
nvidiaNoZones: {name}: no LEDs controllable through NVIDIA's official API (normal for cards without RGB or from vendors that use their own controller).

nvidiaZones.one: {name}: {n} light zone — shown in the list as a device.
nvidiaZones.other: {name}: {n} light zones — shown in the list as a device.

others: NVIDIA cards with NVIDIA's lighting API and Sapphire, PowerColor, ASUS, MSI and Gigabyte AMD cards work straight through the driver, with no other apps.

amdZones.one: {name}: {n} LED controlled straight through the AMD driver — shows up in the list as a device.
amdZones.other: {name}: {n} LEDs controlled straight through the AMD driver — show up in the list as a device.

amdSilent: {name}: known RGB model, but the LED chip did not answer (another RGB app open, or different firmware).
amdNoRgb: {name}: no known LEDs (reference card, integrated graphics or a model not on the list yet).
